extra.ground_truth: The bathyscaphe Trieste made the first crewed descent to the Challenger Deep on 23 January 1960, crewed by Jacques Piccard and US Navy lieutenant Don Walsh, reaching a depth of roughly 10,911 m (about 35,800 ft).
